description: ImpAI builds (tagpu/ddraw/src/tagpu_impai.c; the brain, impai_brain.c, impai_econ.c, impai_build.c): Comet Catcher with fixed starts, true line of sight, mapped, at Easy, so both branches of every handicap stub the economy reaches run each pass. ImpAI's seat plays its Hard level all the same: the test group's content (tools/impai/level_lever.py, `1=hard`) writes tagpu_impai_level.on before each launch, because the economy's bar is the brain test's economy game on the Hard row, and the Difficulty's handicap and ImpAI's level stay independent. Seat 0 is an idle human (ARM, StartPos1) with two Fleas on hold, west and east of seat 1's start (5184, 560); seat 1 is ImpAI (CORE, StartPos2, so the launch writes `seatai=1`) and seat 2 OTA AI (CORE, StartPos3) with two A.K.s on hold in the map's far corner (384, 384), about 8 620 from its start (5712, 7216). The `impai-eco` test group orders both Fleas onto seat 1's commander at GameTime 4700, so the on-hit commander purge's site (row 18) runs on ImpAI's branch, once the economy's bar holds: a 400-energy D-gun shot, which ImpAI's military may order (impai_mil.c, dgun), can put the store under the stall line ahead of the plant before then (tagpu/ddraw/tests/impai_brain_test.c, EGAME_FLEA). Where they stand: seat 1's commander builds within R, the hull of the four patches nearest its start and the ring sites its brain's model and the 2026-11-12 recording used, grown by a builder's stand offset (half the footprint plus 23 px), x 4937..5799, z 217..1015. The Fleas start at (4704, 288), 315 px outside R, and (6080, 960), 320 px outside it, beyond a Flea's own 300 on hold and the D-gun's 240, so nothing fires before the order, and clear of the border mask (0x4833B0: the last two columns, and the top rows only while row x 16 is under half the height); the unused patches nearest them are 810 and 376 px away. Over R the nearer Flea is at most 872 px away in a straight line and 919 by the shortest 8-way path a Flea's class can walk (KBOTSS2: maxslope 32 on each cell's 2 x 2 heights, every feature footprint taken as blocking; the only cells refused inside R are the four patches' features). So one of them is within 263 of a commander standing anywhere in R, 263 being its sight under true line of sight, after 21 ticks of acceleration (0.14 a tick to 3) and (919 - 263 - 32) / 3 = 208 more, and fires within the 24 ticks of its reload: by GameTime 4953, 447 before the end [INFERRED: the engine's path is no longer than the shortest 8-way one]. A commander that walks away the whole time is closed on at 3 - 1.07 = 1.93 a tick: (919 - 263) / 1.93 = 340 ticks, with the acceleration and the reload a hit by 5085. A Flea's beam outranges both of the commander's weapons (ARMFLEA_WEAPON: range 300, 8 a shot every 0.8 s; CORCOMLASER 200, CORE_DISINTEGRATOR 240), so it hits first, and an ImpAI seat's commander keeps its orders when hit (the exemption's stub at 0x406FC3 takes the unscaled branch 0x406FF6, past the purge). The two cannot kill the commander: from 4700 to the end, 700 ticks, each fires at most 30 shots of 8, so together at most 480 of CORCOM's 3000 (the retail FBIs and weapons.tdf). Nothing attacks seat 2: a stock AI commander that is hit drops its orders and pauses its builder planner 30 to 329 ticks a hit (0x406F80), so a Flea's beam every 0.8 s kept seat 2 from giving any order from GameTime 1212 to the end (MEASURED 2026-11-12, the recording's order lists). Its A.K.s make its orders and the takeover's moves hold by construction (tools/replay/fixtures.json takes the group over at 391, so its window is [391, 2191)): the attack planner 0x4077E0 orders one to three armed mobile units home every 300 ticks whatever the economy, home being the mean position 0x407410 of the seat's armed structures, else its other structures, else its builders (engine/orders.md, the force planners); the A.K.s are in group 3 by GameTime 32 (the group assignment 0x408830, every 30 AI ticks) and ordered home within the planner's next 300, by 332. By 2191 they have walked at most 1.72 x 2191 = 3 769 (CORAK's maxvelocity), and every seat 2 structure stands within a ground builder's reach of its start, at most 1.3 x 2191 + 60 + 91 = 3 000 (CORCV's maxvelocity, the fastest ground builder seat 2 can field by then: CORCH, 2.1, needs a CORHP, 19 005 / 300 s of the commander's workertime, and then 11 028 / 500 s, past 2191; CORCOM's builddistance; half an 8 x 8 footprint's diagonal), so home stays more than 1 800 from them throughout the window and they walk through it: two of the four mobile units the computer seats can hold at 391, the two commanders and these, since no plant of CORE's finishes before 670 (CORVP: 6 700 / 300 a second of its only builder's workertime). The bound does not cover an air constructor, which could carry a structure farther: CORCA needs a CORAP, 7 180 / 300 s, and then 9 286 / 400 s with the commander helping, so from GameTime 1414. Comet Catcher has 3 to 7 metal spots within 1024 of each of its first four starts and a wind of 10..15 (scout I11), so the extractors come from spots and the energy from solar.
